task_intent: Refine Tessera’s personal music library and games with expressive native interfaces and matching wall experiences.

references.name: Abode — Lexico letter puzzle
references.applied: Separate the five-letter composition from a dedicated tactile keyboard, with an explicit Enter action and a clear guess count. Tessera preserves unacknowledged drafts.

references.name: Apple News — crossword input
references.applied: Keep the selected puzzle area prominent; give the input area a distinct visual rhythm and meaningful state feedback.

references.name: Hasbro — licensed Wordle rules
references.applied: Preserve five-letter guesses and six attempts, with repeated-letter knowledge and the completed grid visible. Add underline/dot/dash cues alongside colour. The NYT game page was blocked by robots.txt.

references.name: The Atlantic Magazine — grid puzzle
references.applied: Strong major rules, restrained cell surfaces and a readable context strip directly below the grid. This is a crossword reference: a second dedicated Sudoku search returned no screens.

references.name: Apple News — grid selection
references.applied: Use a firm selected-cell outline with softer related-cell illumination. Sudoku selection reports row, column, given/editable status and mistakes in readable text.

references.name: Nikoli — Sudoku rules
references.applied: Rows, columns and 3-by-3 boxes each contain 1–9 once. Reject invalid givens before solving; preserve the complete grid in the ending; add reversible pencil notes.
